tech_spec.content:
# Checkout API (prototype sample)

Sessions expire after 90 minutes absolute. Idle timeout after 20 minutes.
Password minimum length: 8.
MFA is required for administrative login.
Refresh tokens use rotation.

Encryption at rest is enabled. Edge TLS policy is tls-1-2-strict. HSTS is enabled.

Rate limiting is enforced. All routes require auth via authentication middleware.
OpenAPI document is published.

Production deployment runs with 3 replicas. Readiness probe is configured. Liveness probe is configured.
PodDisruptionBudget is present with minAvailable: 2. Network policies are configured.

Dead-letter queue (DLQ) is configured. Structured JSON logging is required. PII scrubbing is enabled.
Secret scanning is enabled. Required reviews: 1.

code.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet: { path: /live, port: 8080 }
---
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: checkout
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels: { app: checkout }
